items.html: Now, each of these three Ehyeh takes the whole discernment of the twenty-two letters that are alluded to in Kamatz and Patach, in order to make vessels of them by means of the look of the eye at them. If so, each of these names Ehyeh includes the whole discernment of the twenty-two letters. Thus we find three names Ehyeh, together with three times twenty-two letters, with the kollel, amounting to 130, which in Gematria is “eye” [Ayin]. Thus the name SAG is alluded to in the eye as well.
